name: Boku wa Bishoujo Nanka ja Arimasen!
original_name: 僕は美少女なんかじゃありません！
source:
"I lost control of my life one day.
Then I lost even myself.
Lady, I'm a guy!"

A series of misfortunes leaves puts Minato, a boy, in a subservient position under a wealthy girl named Yua who dresses him up, renames him "Mina" and enrolls him at the all-girl college. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE145692.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“有一天，我失去了对生活的控制。
然后，我连自己也失去了。
小姐，我可是男人！”

一连串不幸让男孩凑陷入富家女孩由亚的支配之下。由亚给他换上女装，将他改名为“米娜”，并把他送进女子大学。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE145692.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
